reply: NMSE of about 1.4e-3, far above the 1e-12 that would mean the right structure. Its main pieces are a term of about −4.4/P, which dominates at low density, and a growth rate in P that rises roughly linearly with t. The last equation I scored, which used a sinusoidal growth rate, was worse at 7.5e-2.

best.code:
def equation(t,P,params):
    return params[0]/P + params[1]*P*(1-P/params[2]) + params[3] + params[4]*np.sin(params[5]*t+params[6])*(1+params[7]*P)
